title: The Extraction of Kowloon
author: Sebastian Fairweather
blurb: Hazel Voss, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
